empty.title: No BSI IT-Grundschutz requirements yet
empty.description: Load the integrated BSI IT-Grundschutz catalogue to start tracking implementation.

filterEmpty: No requirements match the filter criteria.

catalogs.title: Grundschutz catalogues
catalogs.intro: Catalogues are imported and stored as a preview first. Requirements are only taken over on activation; status, owners and notes of existing requirements are kept, requirements no longer contained are marked as retired, not deleted.
catalogs.activateConfirm: Activate catalogue "{{name}}"? Its requirements will be reconciled with the implementation status.

diff.title: {{name}} compared to: {{against}}
diff.hint: The preview changes nothing. Changes are applied only with "Activate".

import.title: Import catalogue
import.name: Name (optional)
import.hint: Supported: IT-Grundschutz-Kompendium as XML (DocBook) and OSCAL catalogues in JSON, such as the Grundschutz++ user catalogue. Max. 25 MB.

toast.imported: Catalogue with {{count}} requirements imported as preview

domain.name: Name

approachHint.basis: Entry level: basic requirements only, for the whole domain.
approachHint.standard: Default approach of BSI Standard 200-2: basic and standard requirements.
approachHint.kern: Narrow scope ("crown jewels"): all requirements including high protection needs.

domain.domainWideHint: Process modules (ISMS, ORP, CON, OPS, DER) and practices without a target object category apply to the whole domain.
domain.noTargets: No target objects yet. Assign assets from the asset register.
domain.noTypeSuggestion: No suggestion for this asset type – please choose a type.
domain.suggestHint: Suggestions from the active catalogue. A module is only assigned once you click "Apply".
domain.confirmRemoveTarget: Remove "{{name}}" from the domain? The asset itself is kept.
domain.confirmRemoveModeling: Remove modelling {{module}}? The recorded implementation status is kept.
domain.notInCatalog: Not contained in the active catalogue

check.empty: No requirements yet: assign modules in the "Information domain" tab.
check.justificationRequired: A justification is mandatory for "no" and "dispensable".
check.noDocuments: No documents on the assets of this target object.
check.summaryTitle: Summary by target object and module
check.unmodeledHint: These entries belong to no currently modelled module or to a level outside the protection approach. They remain stored.

approachInfo.basis: Basic protection: the basic requirements (B) of the modelled modules are checked.
approachInfo.standard: Standard protection: basic and standard requirements (B, S) are checked.
approachInfo.kern: Core protection: basic, standard and high-protection requirements (B, S, H) are checked.

check.additionalTitle: Additional requirements from the risk analysis
check.additionalHint: Measures from the treatment plans of the risks classified for a target object in the risk analysis (BSI-Standard 200-3, ch. 7).

riskAnalysis.intro: Target objects with high or very high protection need, without a matching module or with an operating scenario the modules do not cover need a risk analysis (BSI-Standard 200-3, ch. 3). The protection need comes from the CIA assessment of the asset: 1–3 normal, 4 high, 5 very high.
riskAnalysis.withoutProtectionNeed: {{count}} target object(s) without protection need assessment – please assess the asset.
riskAnalysis.empty: No target objects in the information domain.
riskAnalysis.coverageHint: The catalogues do not map threats to modules; whether the modelled modules cover a threat is therefore assessed by hand.
riskAnalysis.notIncludedHint: The target object is not selected for the risk analysis. Include it under "Selection and progress" to edit it.
riskAnalysis.classifyCreateHint: The first classification creates a risk in the risk register (scenario: asset of the target object × threat).
riskAnalysis.classifyUpdateHint: The classification updates risk {{ref}}; no second risk is created.
riskAnalysis.newThreatHint: Creating a new threat requires the permission threats.create.
riskAnalysis.measuresHint: Measures from the treatment plans of the classified risks. They are edited in the risk treatment plan; here they are taken over into the realisation plan.
riskAnalysis.noMeasures: No measures in the treatment plans of these risks yet.

realization.hint: Requirements with status "no" or "partially" from the IT-Grundschutz-Check and the measures taken over from the risk analysis. Suggested priority: basic high, standard medium, elevated protection need low; measures by risk level.
realization.notChecked: {{count}} requirement(s) have not been assessed in the IT-Grundschutz-Check yet and are therefore missing from the plan.

reports.title: Reference documents
reports.hint: Reference documents A.1–A.6 per BSI-Standard 200-2 as Word or PDF file. They contain only what you may see; every download is written to the audit log.
reports.error: The document could not be generated.
